game.desc: de Blob 2 is a platform game for Xbox 360. You must save the megalopolis of Prisma City from sinister dictators with monochromatic urges. The existence of new powers for Blob will sharpen and pigment your adventure through a hundred levels, and a cooperative mode that allows a second player to control a flying robot.
